currentBoundary.note: A2.3b established an exact method/path authorization boundary. Public reads are allowlisted, admin page/theme mutations require admin:content:manage, and editor routes are deliberately unreachable. It did not establish lifecycle, data, wire, or UX parity.

routeBatches.contract: Locale-aware published snapshot only; draft, deleted, unknown locale, and unknown slug are indistinguishable 404s; validators and cache policy are deterministic.
Public-safe published catalog only; admin-only schemas and unpublished navigation are excluded; cache and not-found semantics survive gateway and BFF hops.
Published-only paginated news, real 404 detail, pinned featured ordering, safe immutable media references, and one canonical envelope through BFF/gateway.
Subscription-owned active and public plans only, exact filtering and ordering, one response shape, and invalidated positive/negative caches.
Live analytics data with rank offset and result cap derived only by backend permission/plan authority; anonymous defaults remain backend-owned.
Server-derived owner identity, owner-scoped idempotent watchlist mutation, live rankings join, and no address-selected public portfolio lookup.
Validated versioned CRUD, server actor attribution, transactional publish, media integrity, exact status/envelope propagation, audit/outbox, and idempotency.
Remain fail-closed until verified principal mapping, page/session ownership, expiry, optimistic concurrency, commit validation, and audit evidence exist.

acceptance: Every anonymous query filters an immutable published revision, never a mutable draft row.
Draft, archived, deleted, scheduled, and failed-publish resources return the same public 404 behavior as unknown resources.
Canonical slug normalization and uniqueness are scoped by locale with explicit fallback rules.
Positive and negative cache keys include locale and revision; publish, unpublish, rename, and delete invalidate them.
Create/update reject empty or noncanonical slug/title, invalid locale/theme/status, invalid SEO, and blocks that fail registered schemas.
Updates require a version/ETag and return 409 on stale writes without replacing concurrent edits.
Theme token documents are schema-validated and partial updates preserve unspecified values.
Exactly one safe default is enforced transactionally and in-use themes cannot be deleted unsafely.
Block definitions have versioned schemas, compatibility rules, and validated defaults.
Anonymous catalogs and rendered pages exclude admin_only blocks and secrets.
Actor identity comes only from a verified principal extension and never from JSON or spoofable headers.
Start/commit/list enforce actor and page ownership, expiry, lock/version rules, and replay-safe closure.
Publish validates a versioned draft, writes an immutable revision, flips the public pointer, and records audit/outbox in one transaction.
Unpublish, schedule, cancel, and republish have explicit state transitions and replay behavior.
Upload enforces size, MIME sniffing, extension, digest, object namespace, and authorization before returning a reference.
Publish verifies referenced objects; deletion/garbage collection cannot remove media used by a published revision.
Production authority is declared; filesystem input is either disabled or signed/versioned and path-confined.
Reload replaces registry atomically, rejects the whole invalid generation, and reconciles removals as well as additions.
Versioned reversible migrations replace runtime DDL and include constraints/indexes for locale, revision, state, ownership, outbox, and idempotency.
Dry-run backfill plus repeatable reconciliation proves counts, hashes, orphan handling, and rerun safety.
Plan visibility, rank offset/cap, and portfolio ownership remain backend-owned and cannot be selected by UI/BFF input.
Live sources replace content files and canned responses with parity fixtures for anonymous, free, paid, admin, and foreign-owner cases.
Each public/admin route has one canonical prefix, body, envelope, pagination, field naming, and status matrix.
Gateway, ServiceClient, frontend BFF, and admin BFF preserve 401/403/404/409/422/429/5xx and request IDs without collapsing them.
HTML/JSON/media define Cache-Control, Vary, ETag, content type, nosniff, CSP, frame, referrer, and request-ID behavior by route.
Private/admin responses are non-cacheable and public caches cannot vary on or forward credentials.
Every mutation records actor, request ID, before/after revision, reason, timestamp, and result in an immutable audit trail.
Mutation idempotency keys are owner-scoped with request hashes; outbox dispatch is retryable and replay mismatches return 409.
News, plans, rankings, portfolio, and admin/editor screens distinguish loading, real empty, forbidden, not found, retryable error, and success.
Wire failure never renders canned production-looking content; retry is accessible, bounded, and preserves filters/forms.
Shadow reads and reconciliation thresholds define go/no-go before route ownership changes.
Rollback restores prior routing and read authority without reversing committed published data or losing audit/outbox events.

backendOwnershipRules.rule: Subscription backend owns public/active plan eligibility and promotion validity.
Permission/plan backend derives rank offset and cap; UI, gateway, BFF, and content service cannot widen them.
Verified subject owns portfolio/watchlist selection; arbitrary address path input cannot select protected data.
Verified admin principal owns author/editor identity and content mutation attribution.

wireRules.rule: One external prefix maps to one internal route without alternate canned handlers.
Success, pagination, and error envelopes are identical through service, gateway, and both BFFs.
HTTP status remains authoritative and exact; envelope codes cannot disguise a 200 and clients cannot collapse distinct 4xx statuses.

auditRules.rule: Every mutation audit record uses server-derived actor and correlated request ID.
Public pointer, audit record, and outbox event commit atomically.
Owner-scoped idempotency replays the original result and rejects a key reused with a different request hash.

rollbackRules.rule: Every route batch has an independently reversible gateway/BFF ownership switch.
Rollback never deletes migrated rows, published revisions, audit events, or outbox records.
Documented mismatch, 4xx/5xx, latency, and stale-cache thresholds trigger automatic route rollback.

blockers.summary: Anonymous page rendering does not filter a published revision and can expose a draft row.
blockers.resolution: Introduce immutable revisions/public pointers and prove draft, archived, deleted, and scheduled content are public 404s.

blockers.summary: Locale, slug normalization/uniqueness, fallback, rename, redirect, and true not-found semantics are not defined end to end.
blockers.resolution: Define locale-scoped canonical keys and HTTP 404/redirect policy, then add service/gateway/BFF contract fixtures.

blockers.summary: Content HTML/JSON/media cache keys, validators, invalidation, negative caching, credential variance, and security headers lack a route contract.
blockers.resolution: Specify and test Cache-Control/Vary/ETag/security headers and transactional invalidation for publish/unpublish/rename/delete.

blockers.summary: Page create/update accept weakly validated slugs, locale, theme, status, SEO, and blocks without optimistic concurrency.
blockers.resolution: Add typed validation, version/ETag preconditions, schema checks, exact 409/422 semantics, and parity fixtures.

blockers.summary: Theme JSON is unversioned and weakly validated; partial updates replace omitted token groups with empty objects.
blockers.resolution: Version and validate theme tokens, preserve omitted fields, enforce one default, and protect referenced themes.

blockers.summary: Block types have no complete admin CRUD/version workflow and anonymous catalog queries do not exclude admin_only definitions.
blockers.resolution: Implement versioned schema CRUD/compatibility validation and enforce public-safe projections in catalog and render paths.

blockers.summary: Editor handlers bind caller-supplied user_id and A2.3b therefore keeps every editor route fail-closed at 404.
blockers.resolution: Map verified admin principal to a server-owned actor and keep routes blocked until spoofing/permission fixtures pass.

blockers.summary: Edit sessions lack proven actor/page ownership, expiry, exclusivity/version, close/replay, and visibility rules.
blockers.resolution: Specify session state transitions and enforce owner/version/expiry on start, commit, list, and cleanup.

blockers.summary: Publish is a direct mutable status update without draft validation, immutable revision, transaction, audit, outbox, or cache invalidation.
blockers.resolution: Implement an explicit transactional lifecycle state machine with immutable revisions, compare-and-set, audit/outbox, and invalidation.

blockers.summary: Media upload/reference validation, digesting, object ownership, published-reference integrity, and garbage collection are absent from the target contract.
blockers.resolution: Add safe object metadata and reference tables plus size/MIME/digest/auth checks and published-reference-aware deletion.

blockers.summary: Runtime filesystem watcher and DB sync trust mutable local manifests without generation signatures, atomic replacement, removal reconciliation, or declared authority.
blockers.resolution: Disable mutable production watch or use signed versioned bundles; validate path confinement and atomically reconcile complete generations.

blockers.summary: Runtime CREATE TABLE statements replace versioned migrations, and no legacy backfill or repeatable reconciliation proof exists.
blockers.resolution: Add reviewed reversible migrations, constraints/indexes, dry-run backfill, hash/count/orphan reconciliation, and rerun evidence.

blockers.summary: Target public plans come from content JSON/canned BFF data rather than subscription-owned active/public plans and legacy filter/cache semantics.
blockers.resolution: Make subscription backend authoritative, filter is_public and is_active for list/detail, and prove shape/order/cache parity.

blockers.summary: Target rankings are static and bypass backend-owned permission/plan rank offset and cap enforcement.
blockers.resolution: Route live analytics through backend permission authority and prove anonymous/free/paid boundary fixtures cannot be widened downstream.

blockers.summary: Target exposes address-selected public placeholder/canned portfolio data instead of a verified-owner watchlist plus live ranking join.
blockers.resolution: Restore authenticated owner-scoped overview/watchlist routes, idempotent mutations, and foreign-owner denial fixtures.

blockers.summary: Service, gateway, frontend BFF, and admin BFF have competing prefixes/bodies; the admin BFF preserves an allowlisted status but still emits a bare response while other hops collapse or synthesize envelopes and statuses.
blockers.resolution: Freeze one route matrix and add cross-hop fixtures for body/envelope/pagination/status/request-ID/header preservation.

blockers.summary: Content mutations have no proven immutable audit trail, transactional outbox, owner-scoped idempotency key, or replay mismatch behavior.
blockers.resolution: Persist actor/request/before-after/reason/result with outbox and idempotency in the same transaction; prove replay and 409 mismatch.

blockers.summary: UI fallbacks replace wire failure or real empty states with production-looking canned news, ranking, plan, and portfolio content and lack full error/retry states.
blockers.resolution: Implement explicit loading/empty/forbidden/not-found/error/retry/success states and remove canned fallback from production paths.

blockers.summary: No shadow-read mismatch, stale-cache, lifecycle transition, outbox lag, reconciliation, or route-specific SLO evidence gates cutover.
blockers.resolution: Instrument correlated metrics/logs/traces and define reviewed readiness thresholds with deterministic reconciliation reports.

blockers.summary: No per-batch route rollback, data-forward rollback, cache purge, or trigger threshold is proven.
blockers.resolution: Document and rehearse independent route ownership rollback that preserves migrated/published/audit/outbox data and purges incompatible caches.

requiredExecutionOrder.exitEvidence: Reviewed route, status, envelope, identity, entitlement, cache, and source-of-truth decision records.
Reversible migrations and migration-lint evidence; runtime DDL removed by implementation batch.
Dry-run and rerun reports with counts, hashes, orphans, and zero unexplained mismatch.
Page/theme/block/news/media schema, concurrency, ownership, status, and authorization fixtures.
Immutable revision, public pointer, audit/outbox/idempotency, and invalidation transaction tests.
Live source and anonymous/free/paid/owner/foreign-owner entitlement parity fixtures.
Loading/empty/forbidden/not-found/error/retry/success component and browser coverage without canned fallback.
Server-derived editor identity plus ownership/version/expiry/commit/replay fixtures; only then unblock routes.
Reviewed shadow mismatch, stale-cache, outbox lag, reconciliation, latency, and error-rate report.
Each route batch meets thresholds and its route/data/cache rollback is rehearsed before ownership changes.
